title: Taskflow Rate Limits
description: Caddy HTTP rate-limit activity (HTTP 429) for the Taskflow WAFs. The overview cards, fixed-window cards and the rejection and request-rate charts come from Alloy metrics (all clients, Application filter only); breakdown bars, tables and log samples scan the Caddy access logs in Loki and also honor the Client IP filter. Rankings and log samples are limited subsets, not complete inventories. Individual client IPs and URIs are parsed at query time and are not Loki labels.

panels.title: Overview — all clients; metrics since 2026-10-18 13:34 UTC; Client IP filter in collapsed row below
Total requests
panels.description: Caddy requests handled in the selected range, health probes excluded. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter. The Client IP filtered count is in the collapsed row "Totals filtered by client IP".

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range]))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: All 429 responses
panels.description: Every HTTP 429 response in the selected range, including Caddy rate-limit rejections and upstream/application 429s. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application",status="429"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Caddy rate-limit rejections
panels.description: 429 responses that carry a rate_limit_zone: confirmed Caddy rate-limiter rejections in the selected range. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{application=~"$application",zone=~".+"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Rate-limit share of requests
panels.description: Caddy rate-limit rejections divided by recorded requests in the selected range. Shows 0% when requests exist but none were limited, and no data when no requests were recorded. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter.

targets.expr: (100 * (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{application=~"$application",zone=~".+"}[$__range])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])))) / (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__range])) > 0)) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: 429 responses — 5 min
panels.description: Fixed window: the last 5 minutes ending at the selected range end, which can include data outside the graph range. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter. Zero means no 429s while requests are arriving; no data means no WAF requests in the window.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application",status="429"}[5m])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[5m])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: 429 responses — 1 h
panels.description: Fixed window: the last hour ending at the selected range end, which can include data outside the graph range. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter. Zero means no 429s while requests are arriving; no data means no WAF requests in the window.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application",status="429"}[1h])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[1h])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: 429 responses — 24 h
panels.description: Fixed window: the last 24 hours ending at the selected range end, which can include data outside the graph range. From Alloy metrics, so it covers all clients and honors only the Application filter. Zero means no 429s while requests are arriving; no data means no WAF requests in the window.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application",status="429"}[24h])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[24h])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Fixed-window summaries — each window ends at the range end and can include data outside the graph
HTTP responses by status
panels.description: Every recorded response status in the selected range (probes excluded, honoring Application and Client IP filters). A 200 response does not by itself mean sensitive content was served; a 403 response is not automatically a Coraza block — attribute blocks with the WAF audit panels.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | request_uri != "" | status != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range]))

panels.title: Rejections by source
panels.description: Counts per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes), from Alloy metrics: all clients, Application filter only. Coraza blocks come from interrupted audit records, not HTTP 403. Rate-limiter rejections are 429s carrying rate_limit_zone; other 429s come from upstream/application code. Each source shows zero only while request metrics exist and Alloy is scraped successfully; gaps mean metrics are unavailable.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_audit_records_total{application=~"$application",interrupted="true"}[$__interval])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

(sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{application=~"$application",zone=~".+"}[$__interval])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

(clamp_min((sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application",status="429"}[$__interval])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))) - (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{application=~"$application",zone=~".+"}[$__interval])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))), 0)) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections by zone
panels.description: Caddy rate-limiter rejections grouped by application and rate-limit zone in the selected range. Unexpected zone values are shown rather than discarded.

targets.expr: sum by (zone) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` | label_format zone=`{{.application}} / {{.rate_limit_zone}}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Rate-limited responses
panels.description: Caddy rate-limiter 429s per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes), split by application, from Alloy metrics (all clients). Zones are frontend general and backend api/authentication; upstream 429s appear as Other 429 in the rejection mix. A healthy request-counter series supplies the zero baseline per application; gaps mean metrics are unavailable.

targets.expr: (sum by (application) (increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{application=~"$application",zone=~".+"}[$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Caddy request rate
panels.description: Request rate per application from Alloy metrics (all clients, probes excluded), averaged over the rate window. Uses the zero-origin counter increase divided by the rate window in seconds, including the initial burst of a new series.

targets.expr: (sum by (application) (increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total{application=~"$application"}[$__rate_interval])) / ($__rate_interval_ms / 1000)) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Client and request tables — selected range
Top 10 paths receiving 429
panels.description: Ranked subset of request paths receiving HTTP 429 (query strings removed, aggregated at query time). Thousands of distinct paths can tie at one or two hits and only ten rows are shown; see the path-category panel for total volume.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (request_path) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_uri!="" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` | label_format request_path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .request_uri "" }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 client IPs receiving 429
panels.description: Caddy's resolved visitor IP, parsed at query time to avoid a high-cardinality label. Click an IP to open the Access Logs and WAF dashboards filtered to that client. When the Client IP filter is set, only the matching IP can appear.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | client_ip != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 hosts receiving 429
panels.description: Currently all public TaskFlow traffic uses www.jokelab.dev; the panel is kept for future hostnames on this Gateway.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (request_host) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_host="request.host", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_host != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])))

panels.title: 429 response paths by category
panels.description: Matching 429 requests grouped into bounded path categories, so scans with thousands of distinct paths still show meaningful totals. Every matching request lands in exactly one category; Other collects unclassified paths. Matching is case-sensitive; uncommon uppercase variants land in Other.

targets.expr: sum by (category) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_uri!="" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .request_uri "" }}` | label_format category=`{{ if or (hasSuffix ".zip" .path) (hasSuffix ".tar" .path) (hasSuffix ".tgz" .path) (hasSuffix ".gz" .path) (hasSuffix ".bz2" .path) (hasSuffix ".rar" .path) (hasSuffix ".7z" .path) (hasSuffix ".bak" .path) (hasSuffix ".old" .path) (hasSuffix ".orig" .path) (hasSuffix ".save" .path) (hasSuffix ".sql" .path) (hasSuffix ".dump" .path) (hasSuffix ".swp" .path) }}Archive/backup{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/.env" .path) (hasPrefix "/.git" .path) (hasPrefix "/.svn" .path) (hasPrefix "/.hg" .path) (hasPrefix "/.htpasswd" .path) (hasPrefix "/.htaccess" .path) (hasPrefix "/.DS_Store" .path) (hasPrefix "/.aws" .path) (hasPrefix "/.ssh" .path) (hasSuffix "wp-config" .path) }}Config/source-control{{ else if or (hasSuffix ".php" .path) (hasSuffix ".asp" .path) (hasSuffix ".aspx" .path) (hasSuffix ".jsp" .path) (hasSuffix ".jspx" .path) (hasSuffix ".cgi" .path) (hasSuffix ".sh" .path) (hasSuffix ".pl" .path) (hasSuffix ".py" .path) (hasSuffix ".rb" .path) }}Script endpoints{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/api" .path) (hasPrefix "/actuator" .path) (hasPrefix "/graphql" .path) }}API routes{{ else if or (hasPrefix "/assets/" .path) (hasPrefix "/static/" .path) (hasSuffix ".js" .path) (hasSuffix ".css" .path) (hasSuffix ".png" .path) (hasSuffix ".jpg" .path) (hasSuffix ".jpeg" .path) (hasSuffix ".gif" .path) (hasSuffix ".svg" .path) (hasSuffix ".ico" .path) (hasSuffix ".woff" .path) (hasSuffix ".woff2" .path) (hasSuffix ".map" .path) }}Static assets{{ else }}Other{{ end }}` | drop request_uri, path [$__range]))

panels.title: Top 10 User-Agents receiving 429
panels.description: Top self-reported User-Agent values among 429 responses in the selected range. A browser-like User-Agent does not identify a real browser or person, and it can be spoofed. Empty values are grouped as (missing).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", user_agent=`request.headers["User-Agent"][0]`, request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` | label_format user_agent=`{{ if .user_agent }}{{ .user_agent }}{{ else }}(missing){{ end }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent rate-limited requests (latest 100)
panels.description: Latest 100 Caddy rate-limiter rejections as access-log summaries, including the resolved client IP and Retry-After header. This is a sample: a burst can contain many more matching records than are displayed. Open the Raw JSON evidence row for the complete stored, redacted records.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_method="request.method", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", retry_after=`resp_headers["Retry-After"][0]` | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` | line_format `{{.status}} {{.application}} | {{.request_method}} {{.request_uri}} | ip={{.client_ip}} zone={{.rate_limit_zone}} retry-after={{.retry_after | default "-"}}s`

panels.title: Identity drift — client_ip in pod CIDR
panels.description: Requests in the selected range resolving into the pod CIDR (probes excluded), not affected by the Client IP filter. Legitimate in-cluster Gateway clients appear here occasionally; a sustained value that is not a known internal client means the trusted cilium_host peer changed, so per-client buckets are shared — re-run runbook Stage 0 and update trusted_proxies.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*` [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Pod-CIDR identity samples (latest 100)
panels.description: Access-log summaries whose resolved client_ip is in the pod CIDR: known in-cluster clients, or the trusted-peer fallback after a node change. Open the Raw JSON evidence row below for the complete stored, redacted records.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json status="status", request_method="request.method", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*` | line_format `{{.status}} {{.application}} | {{.request_method}} {{.request_uri}} | ip={{.client_ip}} zone={{.rate_limit_zone | default "-"}}`

options.content:
**What these numbers mean**

- **Coverage:** WAF metrics began on **2026-10-18 at 13:34 UTC**. Earlier requests are available only in Loki. Metric counts use VictoriaMetrics `increase_pure()` to include each zero-origin counter's first burst; they cannot recover requests before metrics began.
- **Filters:** Overview/fixed-window cards and rejection/request-rate charts use metrics: **all clients**, Application filter only. Expand **Totals filtered by client IP (scans logs)** for IP-filtered summaries. Tables, breakdown bars and logs scan Loki and honor both filters. Use `.*` for all IPs.
- **Zeros vs gaps:** Metric zeros require request-counter data and a successful Alloy scrape. Gaps can mean unavailable telemetry. A healthy scrape alone does not prove WAF logs are flowing; check pipeline health alongside these counts.
- **Evidence:** A 200 is not proof sensitive content was served; a 403 is not automatically a WAF block. Caddy rejections carry a nonempty rate-limit zone; other 429s can come from the application.
- **Display limits:** Top tables show at most 10 entries; recent logs show at most 100 records. Counts cover collected data, not guaranteed complete traffic. Credentials and selected query parameters are redacted.
- **Other layers:** Cloudflare blocks and Cilium drops live on **Blocked Sources**.

panels.title: Loki scrape
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics scrape target for the Loki metrics endpoint. Not a guarantee that every log record was accepted.

targets.expr: min(up{job="loki"})

panels.title: Alloy scrape
panels.description: VictoriaMetrics scrape target for the Alloy metrics endpoint. Does not by itself prove logs are flowing.

targets.expr: min(up{job="alloy"})

panels.title: WAF log activity (last 5m)
panels.description: All WAF container log lines (Caddy access records, Coraza audit records, and Caddy/Coraza runtime messages such as per-rule WAF warnings) observed in the last 5 minutes, across applications and clients. Zero with a healthy scrape can indicate an idle site or an ingestion gap.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf"}[5m]))

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections (last 5m)
panels.description: Caddy rate-limiter rejections in the last 5 minutes, all applications, from Alloy metrics. Zero means no rejections with request metrics available and Alloy up; no data means metrics are unavailable.

targets.expr: (sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_rate_limited_total{zone=~".+"}[5m])) or (0 * sum(increase_pure(loki_process_custom_taskflow_waf_requests_total[5m])))) and on() (min(up{job="alloy"}) == 1)

panels.title: Total requests (client-filtered)
panels.description: Recorded Caddy access requests in the selected range, excluding /waf-healthz probes and honoring the Application and Client IP filters. Exact integer count of matching records retained in Loki.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: All 429 responses (client-filtered)
panels.description: Every HTTP 429 response in the selected range, including Caddy rate-limit rejections and upstream/application 429s. Exact integer count. Scans the Caddy access logs in Loki and honors both the Application and Client IP filters.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Caddy rate-limit rejections (client-filtered)
panels.description: 429 responses carrying a rate_limit_zone value: confirmable Caddy rate-limiter rejections in the selected range. Exact integer count. Scans the Caddy access logs in Loki and honors both the Application and Client IP filters.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Rate-limit share of requests (client-filtered)
panels.description: Caddy rate-limit rejections divided by recorded requests in the selected range. Shows 0% when WAF logs exist but no requests match the filters, and 'No logged requests' when no WAF logs exist in the range. Scans the Caddy access logs in Loki and honors both the Application and Client IP filters.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])) / (sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | request_uri != "" | client_ip=~`$client_ip` [$__range])) > 0)) * 100 or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Totals filtered by client IP (scans logs)
Raw rate-limited access records
panels.description: Latest 100 Caddy rate-limiter rejections as stored in Loki, after Caddy redaction. Includes the full stored request and response fields without line_format; upstream/application 429s are excluded.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | client_ip=~`$client_ip`

panels.title: Raw pod-CIDR identity records
panels.description: Latest 100 non-probe access records with client_ip in the pod CIDR, as stored in Loki after Caddy redaction. Not affected by the Client IP filter.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*`
